# Travelers Insurance

> Travelers Insurance provides comprehensive personal and business insurance solutions including auto, home, workers compensation, equipment breakdown, and specialized coverage for manufacturing, marine, and commercial operations.

Travelers offers insurance products alongside risk management resources covering topics like IoT in manufacturing (Industry 4.0), workplace safety, fleet management, and opioid crisis prevention through tools like the Early Severity Predictor. The company serves individual consumers, small businesses, and large commercial enterprises with specialized coverage including ocean marine cargo, oil rig equipment, and workers compensation assigned risk services.

- Workers Compensation
- Equipment Breakdown Coverage
- IoT and Industry 4.0
- Workplace Safety

## Business Insurance Products

- [Workers Compensation Assigned Risk Services](https://www.travelers.com/business-insurance/large/casualty/residual-market): Workers compensation assigned risk residual market services for large business
- [Equipment Breakdown Insurance Coverage](https://www.travelers.com/business-insurance/boiler-machinery/equipment-breakdown-coverage): Equipment breakdown insurance with EnergyMax 21 and BoilerRE coverage
- [Ocean Marine Cargo Insurance](https://www.travelers.com/business-insurance/ocean-marine/cargo): Ocean marine cargo insurance for importers, exporters, and freight forwarders
- [Oil Rig & Equipment Insurance](https://www.travelers.com/business-insurance/property/oil-rigs-equipment): Oil rig & equipment insurance coverage for drilling contractors
